name: io.github.vitexsoftware/mcp-server-relate
title: Relate Graph DB MCP Server
description: Query and manage a local Relate graph database (Cypher 25) from an AI assistant.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SERVER_RELATE_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Directory of the Relate database to serve (default: $XDG_DATA_HOME/relate/mcp)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SERVER_RELATE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Open the store read-only (default true; set false to allow writes)

tools.name: write_cypher
tools.description: Execute one writing Cypher statement (CREATE, MERGE, SET, DELETE, …). `parameters` is passed as the statement's parameters; an object with a `rows` array feeds the statement's `$rows` parameter. Returns the mutation counters.

parameters.description: The statement's parameters; a `rows` array feeds `$rows`.

tools.name: read_cypher
tools.description: Execute one read-only Cypher statement. Returns the result's rows. Write and schema (DDL) statements are rejected.

parameters.description: The statement's parameters; a `rows` array feeds `$rows`.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Get the schema of the graph store: node labels with their property keys and inferred types, and the relationship types between them. `sample_size` bounds how many nodes and relationships are examined per label (larger is slower but more accurate; -1 examines all).

sample_size.description: The sample size used to infer the graph schema. Larger samples are slower, but more accurate. Smaller samples are faster, but might miss information. -1 samples the whole graph.
